svg.aria-label: Picture grid of game birds, all with a general season somewhere in BC. Basic licence only: grouse, sharp tailed grouse, ptarmigan, chukar, gray partridge, pheasant, quail, wild turkey, raven and Eurasian collared dove. Basic licence plus the federal migratory bird permit, $17.00: mourning dove, band tailed pigeon, ducks, coots and snipe, geese, and brant, in Region 2.
svg.text: All have a general season in BC
